method: L1 hyperparameter search · μ+λ ES (μ=2, λ=8)
interpretation: frontierBuyChance=0 — biggest lever. Default 0.4 had brain wasting 40% of between-wave decisions on income buildings whose payoff doesn't materialise within a 20-wave normal match.
panicLives=13 (vs default 5) — switch to defensive slows much earlier rather than dying the moment lives drop.
minDpsTowersForUlt=7, stableLivesForUlt=19 — much more cautious about saving for the ultimate; build a real DPS base first.
expensiveBias=0.58 — pick mid-cost towers, not greediest. Lets cheap keystones (Bolt) into the rotation.
mazeSaturationThreshold=3 — stop wall-building once path-extension gain dries up; redirect gold to towers.
